`--motifs_file`

Transcription factor motifs in JASPAR format. See https://support.10xgenomics.com/single-cell-multiome-atac-gex/software/pipelines/latest/advanced/references

:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--non_nuclear_contigs`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Name(s) of contig(s) that do not have any chromatin structure, for example, mitochondria or plastids. These contigs are excluded from peak calling since the entire contig will be "open" due to a lack of chromatin structure. Leave empty if there are no such contigs.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
List of `string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"chrM"`

[Example]{.arg-key} `"chrM"`

[Separator]{.arg-key} `";"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Output folder
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"cellranger_reference"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}

:::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/reference/build_cellranger_arc_reference/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline/v4.2.0/components/reference/build_cellranger_arc_reference);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline \
  -r v4.2.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/reference/build_cellranger_arc_reference/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
